thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: metering anomaly detected in eu-west — token-count spike + transient overage flags for a subset of customers. Auto-alert at 09:18 UTC.
maria: I'm oncall, taking this. can someone post quick customer impact?
kevin: looking at aggregator logs now. seeing consumer lag + replays on kafka partition 12. counts suddenly doubled around 09:17-09:19.
jordan: CS says a few customers received overage emails from the billing pipeline. not widespread yet, but a handful of enterprise tenants.
billing-sre: confirmed: shadow counts and live counts diverge for ~4k sessions. shadow shows expected values, live shows +ve drift. overage detector fired for ~7 accounts.
sam: mitigation idea: pause the overage alerting rule, restart the metering consumer, and run a targeted backfill for affected windows. agree? :thinking_face:
maria: good plan. pausing alerting now (rule: billing_overage_eu).
ops-bot: rule billing_overage_eu muted by maria at 09:22 UTC.
kevin: restarting consumer group metering-eu-agg -> `kafka-consumer restart --group metering-eu-agg --partitions 12`
kevin: grep of logs: `WARN emitter: retrying commit for batch 4821` then `INFO emitter: duplicate ack detected` — looks like a retry storm created duplicate emits.
billing-sre: that matches hypothesis. reconciler should dedupe on event_id but a small codepath bypassed dedupe during a retry window. PR incoming.
maria: initiating targeted backfill for 09:10-09:30 window to recompute counts (job: metering-reconciler --from 09:10 --to 09:30 --region eu-west). kicking off now.
jordan: I've drafted customer note + temporary credit offer for affected tenants. pinging CS to send after we confirm backfill results.
sam: muting noisy downstream alerts: `opsctl alert mute --alert billing_threshold --scope eu-west --duration 2h` -> done.
ops-bot: metering_reconciler job started (job-id r-20260317-09-24).
kevin: consumer restart completed, lag dropped from ~120k->2k in 40s. tailing logs show fewer duplicates now.
billing-sre: backfill in progress, initial diffs decreasing. reconciler found duplicate batch commits and removed ~2.7% of inflated tokens.
maria: monitoring token-delta metrics. putting a 30-minute watch on this. if drift <0.2% after backfill, we'll close pager and notify customers.
jordan: CS will hold sending emails until we see backfill output. if counts revert, we'll retract and issue credits preemptively.
kevin: adding a temporary hotfix to emitter to gate retry path while we patch: toggled `EMITTER_STRICT_DEDUPE=true` in eu-west canary.
billing-sre: hotfix applied to canary; no regressions so far. planning rollout to rest of cluster after backfill finishes.
sam: FYI muted alerting, but created a ticket for follow-up postmortem: #INC-7321.
maria: handoff to kevin for overnight watch at 09:40 UTC. I'll update runbook and TTR estimate.
kevin: ack. I'll watch the reconciler output and escalate if residual drift >1% or if new overage flags appear.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated to S2. Timeline recorded: root alert 09:18 UTC, mitigation steps applied 09:22-09:30 UTC, backfill started 09:24 UTC.
maria: thanks team — good fast work. I'll draft a short post-incident note once we have final reconciliation numbers.
